headline: Saudi Aramco Attacked, Adding Pressure to Global Oil Supply
summary: Saudi Aramco was attacked, adding pressure to global oil supply. The report names crude oil, oilfields and natural gas among the affected areas, with major OPEC producers involved.
why: Saudi Aramco is the state-owned oil giant of Saudi Arabia and one of the world's largest crude producers, so disruptions to its operations feed directly into global oil prices.
why_moved: The attack is reported to add pressure to global oil supply, which typically lifts crude prices.
